The corpus confirms both helpers.

```json
{"facts": {"dedent": "textwrap.dedent", "clean": "inspect.cleandoc"}}
```

- `textwrap.dedent(text)` removes any common leading whitespace from every line in the text. It is documented in `library/textwrap.rst`.
- `inspect.cleandoc` cleans up docstring indentation. `inspect.getdoc` is documented as returning the docstring "cleaned up with `cleandoc`" (in `library/inspect.rst`), and `library/ast.rst` also refers to `inspect.cleandoc` for cleaning a docstring's indentation. I did not open the `cleandoc` entry itself in `library/inspect.rst`, only these references to it.

Sources: `library/textwrap.rst`, `library/inspect.rst`, `library/ast.rst`
